idea: Use "deletion with re-expansion": take the k×k grid with k = ⌈√n⌉ and delete the k²−n surplus cells chosen as a whole row segment. Then merge the freed space with neighbouring cells into larger squares (e.g. delete 3 cells of a 2×2 corner and enlarge the 4th to side 2/k). Enumerate merge shapes j×j costing j²−1 deletions and gaining (j−1)/k each, which turns padding waste into sum.
